description: Complete pacs.008 message with all optional elements populated. Demonstrates the full richness of the pacs.008 format including payment type information, charges, intermediary agents, structured addresses, regulatory reporting, and remittance information.
test_coverage: Group header with total settlement amount and settlement information (CLRG method, FEDWIRE clearing system)
Payment identification with transaction ID and UETR (gpi tracking)
Payment type information (instruction priority, service level G001 for gpi, local instrument WIRE, category purpose SUPP)
Charge bearer DEBT (debtor pays all charges)
Multiple charges information entries (sender and receiver bank charges)
Full debtor and creditor information with structured postal addresses
Instructions for creditor agent and next agent
Both unstructured and structured remittance information with referenced document
business_rules_expected_to_pass: PACS008-AM03: IntrBkSttlmAmt and InstdAmt currencies match
PACS008-DT01: Settlement date not in past
PACS008-RF03: UETR is valid UUID format
PACS008-GH03: Total settlement amount matches sum
PACS008-XF02: Exchange rate present when currencies differ
notes: This comprehensive test message demonstrates all major features of pacs.008.001.10. It represents a USD domestic wire transfer (Fedwire) from San Francisco to New York with gpi tracking, intermediary routing through Citibank, full charge details, and complete regulatory/remittance information. This is semantically equivalent to the full_valid.mt MT103 test case for round-trip testing purposes.
